objective: Improve both MAE and MSE of PhysioNet Challenge 2019 point-missing version_0 by direct weight-space programming; no training, optimizers, backpropagation or gradient information.
checkpoint_choice: ctimba_mimic-iii-challenge_point/version_0/epoch=49-val_loss=612.00507.ckpt; selected explicitly by the user after comparison with earlier exploratory results.
completed_previous_task: METR-LA point version_0; evidence and edited checkpoints preserved.
selection: Analyze weights and calibration patients from the original validation split; confirm on disjoint validation patients. Freeze every proposed edit before test. Expand the preliminary 128-patient evidence and repeat fixed inference seeds.
test_policy: Use complete 4033-patient test with 100 imputations and paired original/edited randomness. Do not use test examples to derive edits. Retain every benchmark result, including regressions.
test_history: No clinical test evaluation has been performed in this study yet. If further candidates are tested after the first assessment, disclose benchmark reuse.
required_success: Both MAE and MSE must decrease versus the original checkpoint. Report absolute scores, percent changes, and uncertainty; never call a MAE-only gain successful.
paired_randomness: Same missing masks, per-patient seeds and noise schedule for all comparisons.
bootstrap_unit: Patient: one 48-hour window per patient. No temporal-day grouping across distinct patients.
artifacts: Original checkpoint immutable. Save all edit recipes, hashes, measurements, tensor diffs, and an inference checkpoint only after a complete paired test supports joint improvement.
